episodes.title: 10 Revelations From Survivors of The Family, Australia's Notorious Cult
episodes.description:
On 14 August 1987, police walked into a house on Lake Eildon, in Victoria, and found children with identical bleached hair who had been raised by women they called Aunties and a leader they called Mother. Ten revelations from survivors of The Family, the group led by Anne Hamilton-Byrne, told through their own accounts and the findings of police and courts.

This documentary covers how the children came to the group, their appearance, the isolation at the property known as Uptop, the drugs, the hunger and beatings, the punishment with water, the LSD clearings, the escape of Sarah Moore and Leanne Creese, the 1987 raid and Operation Forest, and what was never charged. Accounts of what happened to the children are survivors' recollections and have not been tested in a criminal trial. Hamilton-Byrne was convicted only of making a false declaration and was fined five thousand dollars. Sources differ on how many children were taken in the raid and on how many were acquired by the group.

If a child in an institution is unusually quiet, what would you want an adult to do before accepting that all is well? Share your answer and subscribe to Australian Influence Files.

Figures, dates and costs may vary depending on the sources.
